purpose: Test pre-signal 120-to-20-session price momentum, avoiding short-term reversal; compare fixed top quartile with same-day eligible 128-name historical sample
months: first exchange session each month April-Dec 2023 and Jan-Nov 2024
frame_membership: use exact per-year 128 issuer frames already fixed in lowvol study; no replacement

signal.signal_value: adjusted close at signal day minus 20 sessions / adjusted close at signal day minus 120 sessions - 1
signal.selection: highest ceil(25% of eligible), tie canonical ID ascending
signal.filter_new_requirements: none beyond source validation and signal daily status; never use outcome for eligibility

outcome.exit: 20th trading session after signal at close
outcome.comparison: mean selected net price return minus mean full eligible net price return
outcome.market_benchmark: not needed for primary matched-universe comparison

post_run: Do not re-optimise, reverse sign, or discard months. Failing = stop this factor. Passing = descriptive support only; independent prospective validation still required.
